name: NEONTRIP Voice Copilot Agent
topic: KI-Telefonie, Live-Gespraechsbegleitung, geprueftes Wissen und sichere Lead-/Offer-Follow-ups

source_of_truth.customer_request_and_contact_binding: Ops Postgres/Supabase customer records keyed by exact request_id
source_of_truth.offer_context: Internal Offers API and Offers database; Trello IDs are bounded aliases only
source_of_truth.outlook_context: Postgres customer_email_messages mirror with optional read-only Microsoft Graph evidence
source_of_truth.approved_knowledge: Ops Postgres voice_knowledge tables after human review
source_of_truth.call_eligibility_and_state: Ops Postgres voice platform tables and atomic RPCs
source_of_truth.realtime_transport: Long-lived voice runtime using provider adapters and OpenAI server-side sideband
source_of_truth.workflow_transport: n8n is dispatcher and outcome/error projection only

communication_approval.internal_browser_or_live_copilot_test: Requires explicit participant consent and separate paid-test approval
communication_approval.allowlist_outbound_test_call: Requires a newly approved exact number, internal-test request, active allowlist, documented authorization and separate call confirmation
communication_approval.customer_call: Requires active inquiry, exact request/contact/phone/purpose consent binding, no withdrawal or DNC, campaign/time/attempt gates, approved prompt/model, legal approval and explicit customer-call approval
communication_approval.customer_email_or_message: Not available to this agent; must use the parent communication workflow with deterministic validation and human approval
communication_approval.push_deploy_migration_or_workflow_activa: Each is a separate approval and never implies permission to call or communicate

verification_commands: node --import tsx --test tests/quotes/voice-copilot.test.ts tests/quotes/voice-knowledge.test.ts tests/quotes/voice-platform.test.ts tests/quotes/offer-call-context.test.ts
verification_notes: Focused local suite passed 55 of 55 tests.
Static evaluation contract contains 56 unique German scenarios in 12 required categories.
Voice runtime TypeScript build and repository typecheck passed.
No full Next.js rebuild was run because this handoff changes documentation only.
No live system, provider, customer data, paid evaluation or real call was used.

provenance.method: Full relevant thread inventory verified against current repository files, Git history and focused local tests; live evidence intentionally excluded
